column4: why the measured list is wrong

Ghidra's function here was 4 bytes long (the routine is 0x74) until ApplyTypes followed its code past two mistaken pointers (2026-11-10); the list is kept as the complete one: it loads vertex pointers into r2 and r3, steps r4, counts r5 down and works in fr0-fr3 and fr7; fr4-fr6 are pushed and popped
pair moves under fschg and the frchg bank swap are read as single front-bank registers: r5 is stepped and stepped back, fr7-fr11 are not written and XMTRX is put back
one instruction (fldi1 fr4) that falls into lit_groups_send_alpha, which writes every scratch register
falls into intensity_send_alpha, which changes r0-r7 and fr0-fr11
its specular body (0x0C10ABB6 on) lies outside Ghidra's function and uses r7 for the vertex control word (0x0C10ABD6, 0x0C10AC6C)
its specular body is the separate entry intensity_tri_send_spec, which uses r7 (0x0C10B58C, 0x0C10B620)
its specular body intensity_spill_tri_send_spec uses r7 (0x0C10C6EE, 0x0C10C790)
Ghidra's function stops at the jmp to the hook (0x1a bytes of 0x100): the run loop and the senders it calls change r0-r6 and fr0-fr7; r7 and fr8-fr11 are kept

Ghidra's function here is 6 bytes long (mov.w, bra, nop): the entry branches to the scaling code after mtx_rot_z_rad's entry (0x0C12D4E8, counted with that entry since 2026-11-10), which turns the radians into sine and cosine in fr4 / fr5 and goes on by braf into mtx_rot_y_sincos; the list is the one measured while the scaling code was part of this function
four instructions that branch into the middle of vec_to_local_regs (0c0f584c), which leaves the point in fr4-fr6 and changes fr0-fr3 and fr7; Ghidra's function stops at the branch
four pushes that fall into argb_strips_send_from_hook, which sends the strips (r2-r6 and fr0-fr7 changed, r7 and fr8-fr15 kept); Ghidra's function is the 10 bytes before that entry
